question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a grey ball, Bob has a silver ball, Claire has a blue ball, Dave has a teal ball, Eve has a white ball, Fred has a purple ball, and Gertrude has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Eve swap balls. Then, Bob and Fred swap balls. Then, Fred and Eve swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Then, Bob and Dave swap balls. Then, Bob and Alice swap balls. Finally, Fred and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) grey ball
(B) silver ball
(C) blue ball
(D) teal ball
(E) white ball
(F) purple ball
(G) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: (grey, silver, blue, teal, white, purple, brown)
1. Dave ↔ Eve: (grey, silver, blue, white, teal, purple, brown)
2. Bob ↔ Fred: (grey, purple, blue, white, teal, silver, brown)
3. Fred ↔ Eve: (grey, purple, blue, white, silver, teal, brown)
4. Dave ↔ Alice: (white, purple, blue, grey, silver, teal, brown)
5. Bob ↔ Dave: (white, grey, blue, purple, silver, teal, brown)
6. Bob ↔ Alice: (grey, white, blue, purple, silver, teal, brown)
7. Fred ↔ Bob: (grey, teal, blue, purple, silver, white, brown)
Gertrude has the brown ball, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
